params.prompt: Premium Korean mobile-app performance ad key visual for Meta feed, 4:5 vertical. High-end glossy 3D render, studio lighting, soft shadows, crisp details, eye-catching. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no people, no hands, no money. Leave the upper 35% of the frame as clean empty background for a big headline and the bottom 15% clean for a CTA button. Concept: insurance coverage gap alert. A glossy smartphone floats tilted at a dynamic angle in the lower center; from its screen a large frosted-glass push-notification card pops out toward the viewer with a bright red notification badge and a bell icon. Next to it a 3D clipboard checklist with three blue checked boxes and one empty dashed box glowing red. Soft pastel sky-blue gradient background with subtle light rays.
